componentPatterns.nav: Three-tier sticky header extracted 2026-09-15 from bancofalabella.cl at 1440px. 1) 40px utility bar #347B23: Personas (active, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) chip) + Empresa left; Falabella/Viajes/Seguros/Sodimac/Tottus/Educación Financiera right, 13px/500, white at 75% opacity. 2) 72px white middle bar: palta logo + stacked Banco/Falabella wordmark left; Buscar outline pill (green text #3B9326, 1px rgba(27,48,82,0.3) border, 40px, radius 512px) + Hazte cliente (bg rgba(59,146,38,0.12), text #347B23) + Mi Cuenta (filled #3B9326) right. 3) White text nav, 14px/600, color #585D61, 55px row, centered items: Tarjetas CMR, Cuentas, Créditos, Avance y Súper Avance, Beneficios y Fpuntos, Inversiones, Seguros, Ayuda y Contacto. Mega menus on hover.
componentPatterns.cards: White surface, 24px radius, shadow 0 3px 6px / 0 1px 1px rgba(0,51,102,0.05). Opening/Gennial cards: padding 36px 24px, 12px internal gap, CSS credit-card mockup left of copy, 56px/256px green pill CTA. Benefit promo cards: 395×456, 16px radius, photographic/gradient overlay, large 'Hasta N% dcto' + 'Sin Tope'. Product cards (if used): 292×456, 24px radius.

buttons.primary: Fully rounded pill (radius 128px), background #3B9326, white text, 16px/450, height 56px, padding 16px, min-width ~256px on marketing CTAs. Header pills are 40px tall, 14px/500.
buttons.secondary: Fully rounded pill, background rgba(59,146,38,0.12), text #347B23, 1.5px matching border. Search uses transparent bg + 1px rgba(27,48,82,0.3) border and green text.

componentPatterns.grid: Homepage opening cards: two-up, 32px gap, max 546px each. Benefit promo row: 3 columns ~395px. Inner catalog: 3-column card grid collapsing to 1 on mobile. Content max-width 1248px with 96px page gutters at 1440px.
componentPatterns.hero: Full-bleed white section, padding 32px 96px. Large 1248×460 banner, 24px radius, image/gradient with left text overlay (40px/500/-0.8px tracking, white). Green 56px pill CTA. Dot pagination (active lime). Separate mint (#EFF8EA) credit-simulator strip: 32px headline left, 328px RUT input (8px radius, #C9D4DF border, 54px) + matching-width green pill right.
componentPatterns.footer: Charcoal #262729. Three columns: NUESTRO BANCO / SERVICIO AL CLIENTE / LINK DE INTERES. Column titles 16px/450, letter-spacing 2px, uppercase, #C9D4DF. Links 14px/450 white. Legal CMF disclaimer at bottom in muted gray. Demo-management controls sit in a thinner bar under the legal row.
